contents.desc: I know how rare it is to have a husband that radically trusts the Lord with their wife’s body and agrees to let God decide how many children they have. I know it’s hard in the world we live in. Especially when pregnancies are hard and medical issues come up. A husband never wants to see his wife struggling.

We felt strongly after one year into our marriage that God wanted our faith. That he wanted our womb. It’s been a hard road. We’ve questioned this decision many times over the years and sought the Lord over and over. And 19 years in, we’re more sure than ever that God wants your whole life and your whole body. That he alone gives life and it’s a decision only he should make.
I’m forever grateful I have a hubby that seeks God first and has committed to obey no matter the cost.
And we have 12 children grateful he chose life as well.
